# Cncf Tencent Cloud Serverless Cloud Function Reviewer

Review Tencent Cloud Serverless Cloud Function using its official documentation and repository in the Serverless / Hosted Platform category. Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment provided by Tencent Cloud for enterprises and developers to help you run your code without purchasing and managing servers.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
